messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: High 429s observed from hotpath GPU pool in us-west-2 — 60% of requests returning 429 over the last 2m. On-call: @eric_p — please ack and triage.
eric_p: acked. pulling logs now. seeing steady queue growth on hotpool-service, autoscaler logs show 'max_replicas=12 reached' and repeated 'scale denied: quota' errors.
lucy: looking at rate policies — tier=hotpath has tokenbucket refill=600/s but per-route multiplier for /v1/chat is 0.05, so effective refill is tiny. that explains token shortage under burst.
ajay: autoscaler hit a soft limit because we recently tightened per-customer reserved capacity. can add providers/gpus but it'll be ~5-7m to provision. do we want quick capacity or config change?
eric_p: quick plan: 1) temporarily increase tokenbucket refill for hotpath tier, 2) permit a fast add of +3 GPUs to hotpool, 3) enable fallback to cpu-quantized model for non-critical routes, 4) isolate top offending API key if needed. agree?
lucy: +1. I'll patch tokenbucket now to bump refill to 1800/s and raise burst to 2400. applying via admin API.
lucy: ```PATCH /admin/ratepolicies/hotpath
{
  "tokenbucket": { "refill_per_sec": 1800, "burst": 2400 }
}
```
ops-bot: autoscaler: request accepted, initiating scale plan. provisioning 3 GPUs to pool hotpath-usw2. ETA ~6m.
eric_p: while that provisions, I'm going to open a short-term rate limit for the top noisy key from customer 'summit-ai' to protect others. maria_cs can you confirm if we can throttle them for a few minutes?
maria_cs: yes we can. CS reached out to Summit support and they agreed to a temporary cap. I'll apply a 30% rate cap on their key and notify them.
sre_tom: noting we also have an unrelated config where tier policy fallback mapping prefers the same hotpool; we should change fallback to use the overflow L1 pool to avoid hotpool loop. creating a quick patch.
eric_p: applying overlay to tier fallback to prefer overflow-L1. ```PATCH /admin/tierconfigs/hotpath
{
  "fallback_order": ["overflow-L1","spill-usw2"]
}
```
lucy: tokenbucket change applied. monitoring token fill metrics... tokens_consumed dropping slightly, 429 rate down from 60% to 38%.
ops-bot: autoscaler: 3 GPUs provisioned and joined pool hotpath-usw2. current replicas=15.
eric_p: good. drop in 429s to 18% now. latency still elevated for some prefix-heavy requests.
ajay: spun up an extra warm worker group for KV-heavy small-requests — should reduce CPU overhead on GPUs. `/infra/resize --group hot-kv-warm --add 4` done.
lucy: seeing improved tail latency. 429s trending to ~7% over last 90s.
maria_cs: Summit reports partial recovery on their side. CS sent an update to the customer and noted the temporary cap. they appreciate the quick communication. :white_check_mark:
eric_p: next steps: revert temporary per-customer cap after stabilization, review tokenbucket multipliers (per-route vs per-model) in config, follow-up change to autoscaler max_replicas to avoid hitting soft quota during burst, and draft runbook entries for tokenbucket misconfig. I'll file a post-incident doc.
sre_tom: logging action items: (1) increase default hotpool max_replicas by +20% (2) add health check to detect tokenbucket underfill for hot tier (3) add canary policy to fallback mapping so fallback doesn't target same pool.
lucy: adding test case to CI that simulates small-request-heavy workload to detect per-route multiplier issues.
eric_p: thanks all — closing paging once 429 < 1% for 10m. leaving this thread open for follow-ups and I'll create the incident ticket with timeline and customer impact. :eyes:
